Row.Cell: I have learned to keep this darkness on a leash. To give it rules, and choose only those whose guilt leaves no room for doubt. But the hunger has returned, and I cannot hold it back for long.
I have learned to keep this darkness on a leash. To give it rules, and choose only those whose guilt leaves no room for doubt. But the hunger has returned, and I cannot hold it back for long.
The Passenger senses rot in Pritoky. Before I pass sentence, I must learn who here truly deserves to die.
Every whisper and trace now points to one person. The Passenger has chosen; all that remains is to carry out the sentence.
The sentence has been carried out. Now I must leave no trace.
The work is done. Now I must make sure no one connects it to me.
Everything is quiet. No one saw a thing. The Passenger is satisfied, and the world is a little cleaner.
There were loose ends, but I cut them. It is enough to quiet the Passenger.
It was not clean. I left too much noise behind. The hunger is sated, but the price will keep rising.
Death found the chosen one without me. The case is closed, but the Passenger got nothing from it.
The hunger is sated. For now.

The hunger is quiet. My hands are steady, my thoughts clear. But I know this silence will not last.
